evidence: Carries the Tests label and adds unit and functional test coverage while addressing coverage report non-determinism across multiple test harnesses.
rationale: Adds unit and functional tests for CompactSize deserialization exceeding MAX_SIZE to ensure deterministic coverage of an otherwise untested guard. The author noted that 'Removing the check would pass all tests' and cited 'accidental non-deterministic coverage through tx-deser "fuzzing", which hurts coverage reports'. Reviewers confirmed that prior to this change, no unit or functional tests caught a mutation deleting the MAX_SIZE check.
